crossRefs.note: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.
I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.
Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I…
You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

translations.web: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.
translations.bsb: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
translations.kjv: KOPH. I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
translations.asv: QOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.
